avis.texte: I’ve been using this Multi-Peptide + Hyaluronic Acid serum for about four weeks now, and I’m genuinely impressed. Right away, the texture stood out: it’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any sticky residue. It layers easily under both day moisturiser and night creams. After consistent use (morning and evening), I’ve observed these improvements: my skin feels more elastic, especially around the jawline and cheek area; fine lines near my eyes seem slightly less pronounced; and overall my complexion has a smoother, more even feel. The hyaluronic acid infusion clearly helps maintain hydration, and the peptide complex gives a subtle firming effect that you can actually feel after patting it in. There’s minimal scent (which I much prefer), and the packaging is clean and functional. I did find one small caveat: if I use too much and don’t follow with a moisturiser, the serum alone doesn’t feel quite rich enough for my skin type on very dry mornings. But that’s a minor quibble — it’s easy to solve by adding a light cream over top. Bottom line: If you’re looking for an anti-aging serum that delivers real results (rather than just promises), this is a standout. With consistent use, I’d confidently recommend it — and I’ll be keeping it in my rotation.

While I like to look put together and occasionally go all out with hair and make up, I’m really a low maintenance kind of lady. The high cost of products and learning the proper way to use products has always been a turn off for me, so I’ve never had a skincare routine. However dry wrinkled aging skin is a bigger turn off! Now, at age 45 and perimenopause setting in, aging has begun. I decided about 8 months ago it was long past due that I started a skin care routine and try to preserve any healthy youth I have left in my skin. After lots of research I decided to try the brand Ordinary. The main driving point of selecting this brand was cost. After 8 months of trying several items in their product line, here is my take away. Pros Affordability being number one.: Highly budget-friendly, allowing a full, effective, science-backed full skincare routine to be built for under $100 Transparency: Clear, ingredient-focused formulas (e.g., Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%, Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5) with no hidden additives. Effectiveness: I definitely see an improvement in my skins texture, hydration, and brightness. Range: Wide variety of products addressing specific concerns, including acne, aging, and hyperpigmentation. Cons Complexity: It is confusing when trying to build a routine; It requires research to understand layering, contraindications, and proper application. Ive been using the line for almost a year and I still feel like I go at it blind and should be doing more or doing things

avis.titre: I have been using this for 4 months with no issues.
avis.texte: This serum made my skin feel smoother and more hydrated after just a few uses. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly and layers well under moisturizer and makeup. I noticed my skin looking brighter and more refreshed within the first couple of weeks. It feels gentle on sensitive skin and never caused irritation or breakouts for me. I also love that a small amount spreads easily across the entire face. The bottle feels high quality and the dropper makes application simple and mess free. Overall, this serum has become one of my favorite skincare products and I will definitely repurchase it.

avis.titre: Surprisingly, I’m seeing small results with this!Surprisingly, I’m seeing small results with this!
avis.texte: For every 10 skin care products that I hear about and purchase, I usually see real results on about .25 of them. I’m a sucker for an instagram influencer and have bottles of serums i’ve purchased to attack my menopausal skin. However, I am actually pleasantly surprised with the serum. I’m not sure if it has something to do with this brand’s hyaluronic serum, but I’ve heard that theirs supposedly goes deeper than surface level. I’m not sure what peptides do, but I am seeing little results after about half of a bottle, and about two months. I put this on at night after washing my face. I put some moisturizer on top of it. I wouldn’t say that this is a miracle worker, and no one else has noticed a difference in my skin, but I feel like my elasticity is better and there are less fine lines, probably because my skin is more plump. I do like this brand because I feel like you get more for the money and I’ve been pleased with everything I’ve tried.

avis.titre: Happy with the results at a really good price
avis.texte: For the cost this stuff works really well. I'd been using the Drunk Elephant polypeptide cream for years (which I also found effective!) but got my first facial recently and the facial artist (what are they called? lol) said a serum is better so now I use both. After ~2 months there is a noticeable difference in the feel of my skin. It is like... bouncy. I'm 37 years old. I always felt this way after putting on the Drunk Elephant cream but now I wake up with super soft skin before applying anything. It's much smoother. I recently added the Ordinary's "Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 (with Ceramides)" and am not sure how much more it's doing, but I was already seeing positive results from this serum after just a month or so. Some people on here complain about the price and I'm curious where you might get something else effective, ethical, and decent quality for this price because I think $19 is pretty good for a bottle that lasts me 2 months and has results like these! For context, I'm a 37-year-old female with slightly dry skin and use this twice a day.
I know this isn't the most expensive product out there, but for the cost and only after a few days I have seen some early changes in my skin. I will return to update this but so far so good.

I highly recommend Ordinary products! Easy to use without any irritation. Effective results and a great value for the money! This product helped hydrate and tighten my skin and reduced my wrinkles quickly and effectively and I have made it a regular part of my routine.

This has become one of my favorite skincare items! Goes on very lightweight and doesn’t feel sticky or anything. Very hydrating and layers well under makeup. Doesn’t break me out and I have somewhat sensitive skin, so it’s a very gentle product.

I’ve repurchased this serum several times and it has become a regular part of my skincare routine. I mainly use it for the combination of peptides and hyaluronic acid, as I want something that supports hydration while also targeting fine lines, firmness and overall skin texture. The formula contains several different peptide technologies as well as amino acids and multiple forms of hyaluronic acid, which is a good combination for the price. The serum itself does leave a noticeably sticky layer on my skin rather than absorbing to a completely dry finish. I find that I need to use a fairly lightweight moisturiser over it, as richer products can sometimes pill. That is not a major issue for me because I have experienced the same thing with quite a few serums, and once I know which products layer well with it, it is easy enough to work around. With regular use, my skin feels well hydrated and smooth, and I like having a peptide serum as part of my routine for the longer-term benefits to the appearance of fine lines and elasticity. A few drops are enough for my whole face, so a bottle lasts a reasonably long time. I also keep coming back to this particular one because the price on Amazon is competitive and I feel the formula offers good value compared with many other peptide serums. Despite the slightly sticky finish, it works well for me and I have been happy enough with the results to keep repurchasing it.

Ho provato The Ordinary Multi-Peptide e devo dire che è diventato rapidamente uno dei prodotti indispensabili della mia skincare routine. La texture è leggera, si assorbe velocemente e lascia la pelle immediatamente più morbida e idratata, senza ungere né appesantire. Dopo alcune settimane di utilizzo costante ho notato la pelle più compatta, elastica e visibilmente più luminosa. Anche le piccole linee di espressione appaiono attenuate e il viso ha un aspetto più fresco e riposato. Ovviamente non fa miracoli dall’oggi al domani: come tutti i prodotti skincare validi, richiede costanza e applicazione regolare per vedere risultati concreti e duraturi. Un altro grande punto di forza è l’ottimo rapporto qualità-prezzo: offre ingredienti avanzati come peptidi e attivi mirati a un costo decisamente accessibile rispetto a molti prodotti simili. Inoltre si integra facilmente in qualsiasi routine skincare. In conclusione, consiglio assolutamente The Ordinary Multi-Peptide a chi cerca un siero efficace, delicato e performante per contrastare i primi segni del tempo e mantenere la pelle sana e curata. Un prodotto serio, che con pazienza e continuità dà ottimi risultati.

avis.titre: Must have for those with sensitivities
avis.texte: I love this product line. I have ridiculous sensitive skin and it took a long time for me to find a product that didn't irritate my skin. Their products feel so nice and hydrating. None of them are oily. Some are a little tacky when layering but I think that means you have to wait a little longer between layers. I feel the quality is great and I have seen results in a 60 day time span. I have deep forehead wrinkles that I am self conscious about and these products have done such a great job plumping my skin back out. All of the ingredients are safe for people like me with sensitivities. I was unsure how and when to layer so chatgpt whipped up a routine for me that I follow religiously. will be sticking with this line!
The ordinary is one of my favorite brands, good products and good price. The hyaluronic acid and peptides keep my skin moisturized and soft. I use this as my first layer of skin care routine.

I love this brand and its simplistic, uniform packaging—it makes my skincare collection look clean and cohesive. Some might see that as a con, but I personally appreciate it. The glass bottle is a big plus over plastic, giving it a more high-quality feel. As for the serum itself, I love that the brand avoids unnecessary fillers. While I can’t speak to the long-term results just yet, I have high hopes based on the ingredient list and my past experience with their products!
